title: Mountains as possible non-human no-go zones
place_text: Secret Mountain, Arizona; Mount Shasta, California; Mount Inyangani, Zimbabwe

tellings.quote: Mount Shasta. You have these places that you see orbs going into the mountain, crafts going into the mountain

plain: Some mountains may be places that non-human beings keep for themselves, where people report "orbs going into the mountain, crafts going into the mountain." Michels raises the idea himself, without naming a source, pointing to Mount Shasta in California, with Secret Mountain in Arizona and Mount Inyangani in Zimbabwe mentioned as similar places, during a talk with a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown.
